name: CaseAntdFocusOutlineRingUaWidth
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-focus-outline-ring-ua-width" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: button.root { outline-style: none } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255); outline-offset: 1px } — the ring's declared width EQUALS Chromium's own `outline-width: medium` (3px) at rest, so the width never differs between planes (antd Button/Switch: --ant-line-width-focus is 3px)
